verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server documents natural-language creation and management of tasks and projects, with example prompts, report generation, and an Asana app inside Claude. However, this operation runs through external AI assistants, and the interactive confirm-before-change tools are limited to Claude and ChatGPT. Native in-product natural-language command coverage (Asana Dash, AI Teammates) is asserted only in marketing taglines, so coverage of the full story is partial. Missing for 10: documented natural-language command control within Asana's own UI, evidence that natural language reaches beyond tasks, projects and reports to broader product operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Create and manage tasks and projects through natural language
Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data
The Asana app in Claude brings your work graph directly into Claude conversations, allowing you to turn AI-powered discussions into actionable work without leaving Claude.
Interactive tools render a confirmation UI before committing a change. These are currently available in Claude and ChatGPT.
